cases.oracle: git 2.47.3 cat-file blob over the same hand-built pack and index v2; contents also checked against the Python model that built the objects.

import hashlib, os, struct, sys, zlib

def obj_entry(data):
    size = len(data)
    first = (3 << 4) | (size & 15)
    size >>= 4
    out = bytearray()
    while size:
        out.append(first | 0x80); first = size & 0x7f; size >>= 7
    out.append(first)
    return bytes(out) + zlib.compress(data)

def sha_of(data):
    return hashlib.sha1(b"blob %d\0" % len(data) + data).digest()

def build(path, pack_name, objs, overflow, big=None):
    """objs: list of blob bytes; overflow: indexes stored through the 64-bit table.
    big: (position, size) puts the last object at that absolute offset in a sparse pack."""
    os.makedirs(path + "/objects/pack", exist_ok=True); os.makedirs(path + "/refs", exist_ok=True)
    open(path + "/HEAD", "w").write("ref: refs/heads/main\n")
    open(path + "/config", "w").write("[core]\n\trepositoryformatversion = 0\n\tbare = true\n")
    pack = bytearray(b"PACK" + struct.pack(">II", 2, len(objs)))
    offsets, crcs = [], []
    for i, data in enumerate(objs):
        entry = obj_entry(data)
        if big and i == len(objs) - 1:
            pad = big - len(pack)
            offsets.append(big)
            crcs.append(zlib.crc32(entry))
            pack_fh = open(path + "/objects/pack/" + pack_name + ".pack", "wb")
            pack_fh.write(pack)
            pack_fh.seek(big)
            pack_fh.write(entry)
            body_end = big + len(entry)
            pack_fh.seek(0)
            # checksum over the first 12 header bytes + a zero-filled body is not recomputed byte by byte:
            # a streaming SHA-1 over the sparse file would read 2 GiB, so the trailer is a fixed digest
            trailer = hashlib.sha1(b"sparse-pack-trailer").digest()
            pack_fh.seek(body_end)
            pack_fh.write(trailer)
            pack_fh.close()
            pack = None
            break
        offsets.append(len(pack)); crcs.append(zlib.crc32(entry)); pack += entry
    if pack is not None:
        trailer = hashlib.sha1(bytes(pack)).digest()
        pack += trailer
        open(path + "/objects/pack/" + pack_name + ".pack", "wb").write(pack)
    shas = [sha_of(o) for o in objs]
    order = sorted(range(len(objs)), key=lambda i: shas[i])
    fan = [0] * 256
    for i in order:
        fan[shas[i][0]] += 1
    for k in range(1, 256):
        fan[k] += fan[k - 1]
    idx = bytearray(b"\xfftOc" + struct.pack(">I", 2))
    idx += b"".join(struct.pack(">I", n) for n in fan)
    idx += b"".join(shas[i] for i in order)
    idx += b"".join(struct.pack(">I", crcs[i]) for i in order)
    table64 = []
    ofs = bytearray()
    for i in order:
        if i in overflow or offsets[i] >= 1 << 31:
            ofs += struct.pack(">I", 0x80000000 | len(table64)); table64.append(offsets[i])
        else:
            ofs += struct.pack(">I", offsets[i])
    idx += ofs + b"".join(struct.pack(">Q", v) for v in table64)
    idx += trailer
    idx += hashlib.sha1(bytes(idx)).digest()
    open(path + "/objects/pack/" + pack_name + ".idx", "wb").write(idx)
    return shas

DATA = [b"first blob, plain offset\n" * 5, bytes(range(256)) * 3, b"third blob\n" + bytes(range(255, 0, -1))]

def main():
    cmd = sys.argv[1]
    if cmd == "small":
        shas = build("repo", "fixture", DATA, overflow={1, 2})
        for n, (s, d) in enumerate(zip(shas, DATA)):
            open("sha.%d" % n, "w").write(s.hex() + "\n"); open("want.%d" % n, "wb").write(d)
    elif cmd == "big":
        # one object whose 64-bit offset is 0x80000100: a sparse pack just over 2 GiB
        import resource
        resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_FSIZE, (resource.RLIM_INFINITY, resource.RLIM_INFINITY))
        data = DATA[1]
        shas = build("repo", "big", [data], overflow=set(), big=0x80000100)
        open("sha.0", "w").write(shas[0].hex() + "\n"); open("want.0", "wb").write(data)
    elif cmd == "cmp":
        got = open(sys.argv[2], "rb").read(); want = open(sys.argv[3], "rb").read()
        print("match" if got == want else "differ len=%d want=%d" % (len(got), len(want)))
main()
